name: team_planning_scenario_costs
description: Get what each scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in costs over its own period, beside the baseline priced over the same days, with the difference: the same totals as team_planning_cost, for every scenario at once. The baseline has no period, so it is not listed. Totals are per currency in `native`, and `converted` is the same in the reference currency at each period's start, null with `missing` saying why. `unpriced` counts the seats that can't be priced and so are left out, never counted as zero; team_planning_cost names them. A scenario that can't be priced has `error` instead of figures. Figures are decimal strings. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
